**Stable ID:** `DATA-07.01` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 07 Benchmark datasets and grading semantics

Define the benchmark record: tasks, metrics, grading procedure, answer formats, and what a score means.

## Deliverables

- Benchmark record schema
- Grading-semantics fields covering metric, aggregation, answer matching and judge type

## Canonical artifact paths

- `schemas/benchmark.schema.json`
- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Grading semantics cite the benchmark's official documentation or harness revision

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each benchmark records its metric definition and aggregation exactly
- [ ] Model-judged grading records the judge and its version
- [ ] Validator enforces required grading fields

## Non-goals

- Hosting benchmark items
- Reporting model scores

  - [ ] `DATA-07.01.T1.S3` Define judge and harness fields
- [ ] `DATA-07.01.T2` Encode

  - [ ] `DATA-07.01.T2.S2` Add fixtures and tests
